subject: Demo Release TODAY!
author: ZombieTron
body:
We were all just too darn eager! Criterions countdown said "countdown to demo day!" so midnight was the start of the day the demo will be released, TODAY!!

8am PST so, about 4pm here??? most new arcade stuff is put on about 10am tho so might be worth trying then if you are near you 360, which I am as I am working from home today!! 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---
